title: Victoria City Highlights: Chinatown, Craigdarroch Castle (1-9pax)
includes: Multiple photo opportunities throughout the tour
Cruise terminal pick-up and drop-off (cruise ship name required)
Private vehicle and dedicated local guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
If not already provided, please inform the supplier as soon as possible of your ship's name, docking time, disembarkation time, and departure time to ensure proper arrangements can be made.
BC law requires children under 40 lbs (18 kg) to use a forward-facing car seat. Available upon request for an additional fee with advance notice.
Children over 40 lbs and under 4'9" must use a booster seat. Up to two booster seats are available at no charge with advance notice.

Just stay tuned in: Your guide will reach out closer to your tour date with exact meeting instructions and final details. We will contact you at the number you provided via Viator messages, text, or WhatsApp (if you provided an international number).
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Victoria in style with our luxury tours, now offering a 3-hour adventure. Discover the beauty, history, and charm of Victoria on a private sightseeing experience created exclusively for your group. Travel comfortably with your own local guide and vehicle while enjoying a relaxed, personalized journey through some of the region's most celebrated attractions.

With comfortable pacing, engaging storytelling, and plenty of opportunities for photos, this tour is ideal for cruise visitors, couples, families, and small groups looking for a memorable and stress-free Victoria experience.

Admission fee not yet included.
